claim_scope: Plumbing smoke only. Do not compare cycles, restart recovery, latency, or infer M2 superiority from this artifact.
known_issues: The requested model field reported the artifact constant while requests used the local-model alias.
Engine cycle index and M0 call count were labeled as the same metric.
Grid restart happened after two cognitive cycles, which meant different world-action counts by condition.
M0 latency used provider prediction timing while Engine latency used caller wall time.
M0/M1 lack the deterministic task-solving specialists available to M2, so M2-M1 mixes competence and orchestration.
Provider attempts/errors were undercounted and asymmetric; M0 grid likely had 29 caught failures, but the raw errors were deleted so their cause cannot be asserted.
The prompt hash covers only the static system prompt, not the dynamic schema, context projection, provider configuration, or full request.
Only summary output was retained; the temporary raw databases were deleted.
One run per hand-built fixture, fixed condition order, no statistical inference.
